svg.title: GS1 mod-10 check digit worked example
svg.text: Check digit worked examples – GS1 mod 10 (GTIN-13), Luhn (serial) and weighted mod 11
A check digit finds most reading and typing errors. All results verified with Python (stdlib).
1 GS1 mod 10 – GTIN-13 of VC20-300 (demo company prefix 9521234, item reference 56789)
GTIN-13 = 9521234567899 as GTIN-14 in AI (01): 09521234567899 (leading 0 does not change the sum)
Read check: Luhn sum over all 10 digits (check digit not doubled) must end in 0. Finds every single-digit error and ~98 % of neighbour swaps (not 09 / 90).
3 Weighted mod 11 (ISBN-10 style) – weights 2, 3, 4 … from the right
Serial digits 254600123: sum = 155 → 155 mod 11 = 1 → check = 10 → 'X' (needs a letter – avoid for serials)
Detection of neighbour swaps (Python test, 20 000 random 9-digit numbers): GS1 mod 10 ≈ 89 % · Luhn ≈ 98 % · mod 11 = 100 %
Project decision: GS1 mod 10 for all GS1 keys (mandatory); Luhn for the optional serial check digit (digits only, never 'X').
